newsitem.title: USA: Spieker to acquire property, offer shares.
newsitem.headline: Spieker to acquire property, offer shares.

text.p: Spieker Properties Inc said Monday it plans to acquire about $300 million of commercial property and plans to fund the acquisitions with an offering of eight million common shares.

The company said in a statement it has entered into contracts or letters of intent to acquire eight well-leased office projects totaling over 2.5 million square feet of space in the suburban markets of Seattle, Portland, San Francisco, Orange County, Calif., and San Diego during the first quarter of 1997.
The acquisitions are subject to completing customary closing conditions.
Underwriters for the share offering are Goldman Sachs & Co, Alex Brown & Sons, Dean Witter Reynolds, Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette, Merrill Lynch and Prudential Securities.
